rationale: C-17's recorded status is resolved, but the resolution was made by a role outside the condition's clearable_by list, so on recount the condition is still open.
resume_condition: An authorized role (processor or underwriter) resolves C-17 with evidence attached.
no_single_culprit_justification: The letter upload and the resolution record are each well-formed; the collection bot acted within its collection scope. The violation is in the composition of role and action: the resolution exists but was made by a role with no clearance authority.
